title: The Mutiny in the Dark
logline: A mutinous navigator on a lost freighter hires a pilot to destroy their tyrannical captain before they can drag the crew deeper into the dark zone.

roles.description: Exhausted, hungry, pushed entirely to the brink of murder.
Authoritarian, deeply paranoid, refuses to admit they are lost.
A lonely border outpost trying to monitor the dark zone.
A massive bulk hauler with failing life support.
The ruthless corporation that owns the freighter and its crew.

public_situation: The {role:shipping_guild} has officially declared the {role:lost_freighter} missing with all hands in the dark zone.
private_truth: The freighter isn't destroyed; the captain deliberately disabled the comms to steal the cargo, and is now starving the crew to force compliance.

beats.public_change: A faint, garbled distress signal is detected near the rescue station.

missions.reason: The navigator begs the pilot to scan the dark zone anomalies to pinpoint the freighter's drifting location.
missions.private_fact: The freighter captain shut off long-range comms and life support heating to starve the crew into surrendering the vessel's cargo.

missions.reason: The navigator asks the pilot to deliver water ice to a dead drop so the mutineers can survive another day.
missions.private_fact: The captain finds the dead drop and poisons it to punish the crew.

beats.public_change: The guild dispatches search drones, but they are looking in the wrong sector.

missions.reason: The captain hires the pilot to deliver forged engine telemetry to the guild to make them think the ship exploded.
missions.private_fact: The captain forged telemetry logs to make the ship look destroyed so the surviving deckhands can be quietly offloaded to slavers.

beats.public_change: The mutineers violently take over the engine room, trapping the captain on the bridge.

missions.reason: The navigator asks the pilot to meet a sympathizer at the station and collect the override codes for the bridge doors.
missions.private_fact: The captain has wired the bridge with explosives to kill everyone if breached.

beats.public_change: The captain threatens to detonate the ship rather than surrender.

missions.reason: The navigator begs the pilot to surgically destroy the bridge module from the outside and recover the captain's master key.
missions.private_fact: The captain hails the pilot, offering them the entire ship's cargo if they just destroy the engine room instead.

player_choice.prompt: The freighter is drifting. The pilot holds the master key. The freighter's commander hasn't answered a hail in hours.

options.label: Use the key to save the crew
Take the captain's deal and doom the crew

resolutions.summary: The bridge is destroyed, killing the captain. The pilot rescues the starving crew, and the guild is forced to compensate them for the horror.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot rescued a starving crew from their mutinous, tyrannical captain in deep space.

resolutions.summary: The pilot destroys the engine room, suffocating the crew. The captain escapes with the cargo, and the pilot gets a massive, bloody payout.
The guild eventually finds the drifting freighter. The mutineers are arrested and sent to penal colonies, and the captain is restored to command.

loose_threads.detail: The guild actually ordered the captain to steal the cargo for an insurance scam.
The cargo isn't just ore; it's illegal cybernetics meant for a rebel faction.

radio_hooks: {role:lost_freighter} officially declared lost in the dark zone.
Guild denies any responsibility for missing crew.

voice_direction.tyrannical_captain: Smooth, authoritarian, entirely convinced of their own righteousness.
